correctness.rationale: The symmetric curve is smooth in all four projective charts, with exact unit-ideal Groebner certificates, so has genus nine and is geometrically integral. The symmetric-square identity reconstructs its smooth genus-three quotient and eight distinct diagonal branch points. Reconstructed 9-by-9 Hasse-Witt coefficient matrix has principal rank-eight minor 1, determinant 0, simple zero eigenvalue; thus its stable Frobenius rank is 8 and a-number is 1. The quotient 3-by-3 Hasse-Witt matrix has determinant 2 and is ordinary. A 2-power degree Prym isogeny transports and subtracts p-rank/a-number, giving Prym dimension 6, p-rank 5, a-number 1. Exhaustive normalized coefficient enumeration plus one diagonal PGL2 orbit extends the invariant to all smooth symmetric members; all computational facts are rechecked by standalone scripts.
